candidates.summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. candidates.summary: Multimodal agents commonly generate freeform reasoning before each action.
